definition: Union of verified current KOSPI/KOSDAQ COMMON and COMMON identities in frozen 2506-ticker historical backtest cohort.
complete_when: Every denominator ticker has approved terminal eligibility outcome and every ADJUSTED_ELIGIBLE ticker has valid parquet+sidecar pair with authority/integrity/identity/duplicate/date gates PASS; pending alpha cannot be silently excluded.
pending_policy: 23 alpha common identities remain denominator-pending until bounded pilot verifies support or Architect explicitly records exclusion/unsupported outcome.
not_applicable_policy: Formal SPAC/PREFERRED/REIT/ETF/ETN are outside adjusted COMMON consumer denominator and are not fetched for this store.
missing_policy: No fill; pre-listing/post-delisting and missing dates remain absent with explicit status.
